steps.title: Why Tiered Storage Matters
steps.text: Tiered storage optimizes cost by moving data between hot (memory/NVMe), warm (local SSD), and cold (object store) tiers based on age and access patterns, saving up to 80%.

steps.title: Tiered Storage Architecture
steps.text: Messages flow from hot tier (in-memory buffer) to warm tier (compressed local segments) to cold tier (S3/Azure archive), with configurable retention thresholds at each level.

steps.title: Cost Optimization
steps.text: With 1 TB per day and 90-day retention, tiered storage reduces costs from $2,700/month to $540/month. For 7-year compliance data, savings reach $336,000.

steps.title: Configuration
steps.text: Configure tiered storage in code with WithStorageMode(Tiered), set hot and warm retention thresholds, and specify cold tier storage like S3 or Azure Blob.

steps.title: Best Practices
steps.text: Start with warm tier only, monitor access patterns to tune transitions, test retrieval times against SLAs, use compression, and set up automated lifecycle rules.
